description: This file defines the Text class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static methods for text manipulation such as length calculation, exact string comparison, text splitting, and formatting. It is part of the calculation engine for spreadsheet text functions.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for text processing functions used in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Calculates the length of a string or array of strings, supporting multi-dimensional arrays.

methods.name: exact
methods.description: Performs a case-sensitive comparison of two text strings or arrays of strings.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Returns the input string or an array of strings, or an empty string if input is not a string.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits text into an array based on specified row and column delimiters, with options for case sensitivity and empty cell handling.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Converts a 2D array of values into a formatted string, with options for formatting mode.
